name: tool_foundry
description: Autonomous Dynamic Tool Foundry for synthesizing, sandboxing, verifying, and registering new tools into Flowork OS with zero token bloat.

action.description: Operation to perform: 'create' (stage, test, promote), 'test' (stage and test without promotion), 'retire' (safely unregister/delete tool), 'inspect' (inspect existing tool).

name.description: Tool name in lowercase snake_case (e.g., fl_hash_digest).

manifest.description: The manifest.json dictionary matching the Flowork OS TDK standard.

runner_filename.description: Runner script filename (run.py, run.sh, or run).

runner_code.description: The complete executable source code for the runner script.

test_input.description: Sample input arguments dictionary to inject via stdin during test execution.
